# The Codex — Blood on the Clocktower Character Reference

## What this site is

The Codex is a comprehensive character reference for Blood on the Clocktower, a social deduction tabletop game published by The Pandemonium Institute. It covers all characters across the official editions (Trouble Brewing, Bad Moon Rising, Sects & Violets) plus 70+ experimental characters from the Carousel edition.

## Public pages

- / — Home / landing page
- /reference — Full character reference with filtering by script and team type; includes abilities, night order, tips, bluffing strategies, jinx interactions, and Storyteller how-to-run notes
- /introduction — Beginner-friendly guide explaining Blood on the Clocktower to new players

## What the app provides

- Character abilities and night-order position for every official and experimental character
- Tips & tricks, bluffing strategies, and Storyteller run notes for each character
- Jinx interaction lookup between characters
- Script builder for custom games
- Player tracker / note-taking tool for games in progress (requires login, not indexed)
